origin.description: Fits a cumulative link model from a formula, with optional scale and nominal formulas. Model frames use formulaic; factor levels follow R's order.
origin.usage: clm(formula, scale, nominal, data, weights, start, link, threshold, control)
origin.details: Fits a cumulative link model from a formula, with optional scale and nominal formulas. Model frames use formulaic; factor levels follow R's order.
origin.value: The same value R returns for this call.
origin.example:
data(wine)
fit <- clm(rating ~ contact + temp, data = wine)
fit$coefficients
